newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE may be dragged down to 4,520-4,540.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE may be dragged down to 4,520-4,540.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may be dragged down to the 4,520-4540 region on Tuesday, technical analysts said.

The market did not seem able to successfully fight back recent losses on Monday and the ferocity of the fall on Wall Street last night should guarantee the UK stock market will take fright again today, they added.
A drop to 4,520 would take the index to near its intra-day low of June 3 when it touched 4,524.
By 0716 GMT, at the pre-market open, the FTSE was indicated down 20.9 to 4,554.9.
On Monday, the Dow Industrials tumbled 192.25 to 7,604.26.

A fall to 4,520 would take the FTSE 263 points or 5.5 percent below its closing peak of 4,783.1, set on June 13. In normal circumstances such a move would be regarded as oversold resulting in a subsequent upward bounce, analysts said.

But worries about the forthcoming UK budget and near-term interest rate rises plus the possibility of a further slide on Wall Street will -- at best -- mean an unsettling time for the FTSE and at worst further sharp falls in the weeks ahead, they said.
